query.sql: SELECT "$when" AS dispatched_at, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.to') AS recipient, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.subject') AS email_subject, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.body_text') AS message_body, json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.attachments') AS attachments FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" = 'SendEmailRequest' ORDER BY "$when" DESC LIMIT 25

WITH RankedState AS (SELECT "$producer" AS node_id, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.cpu.usage_pct') AS REAL) AS cpu_pct, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.memory.used_pct') AS REAL) AS mem_pct, CAST(json_extract(raw_json, '$.fields.disk_used_pct') AS REAL) AS disk_pct, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "$producer" ORDER BY "$when" DESC) as rn FROM v_messages WHERE "$type" = 'MessageState') SELECT node_id AS Node, cpu_pct AS CPU_Usage, mem_pct AS Memory_Usage, disk_pct AS Disk_Usage FROM RankedState WHERE rn = 1
